project_context.name: Bookup your Hookup
project_context.description: Adult social networking platform and swinger community for residents of North Alabama and Southern Tennessee.
project_context.vibe: Exclusive, sophisticated, alluring, private club, high-end.

headings.usage_rules: Use for primary headings, hero text, and section titles. Apply tracking-tight for modern elegance.

body.usage_rules: Use for all body text, UI elements, and data. Maintain loose line height for readability.

special.usage_rules: Use sparingly for premium badges, tier names (e.g., Lifetime Member), or contest titles (Pretty Pussy of the Week).

borders.radius: rounded-lg for buttons, rounded-2xl for major cards

surfaces.blur: Use backdrop-blur-3xl for gating content on non-premium profiles

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, py-24. Do not cramp content. Adult sites often feel cheap due to clutter; breathing room creates luxury.
layouts.grids: MODE A: TETRIS for Marketing page. MODE B: HIGH DENSITY for the Member Dashboard and Admin Panel.
layouts.containers: Max width 7xl for general content. Overlapping asymmetrical elements for the landing page.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp with 1px border. Primary actions use the Brand Crimson. Premium actions use Gold.
components.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border, no heavy box-shadow. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and ambient glow.
components.inputs: Dark background (surface_elevated), subtle border, focus ring in brand primary.
components.gated_content: For photos/videos for non-premium members, apply a strong blur filter (blur-xl) and overlay a glassmorphic 'Upgrade to Premium' lock icon and CTA.

motion.hover: Smooth transitions (transition-all duration-300). Slight scale up for cards, border color changes.
motion.entrance: Fade-in up. Staggered children for feeds.
motion.micro: Heart/Like buttons should have a slight 'pop' scale effect.

images.description: Couple silhouette with green hue - use for the main landing page hero background to set a mysterious, alluring mood.
Woman with mysterious black lace mask - use to represent the 'Exclusive Club' or 'Hot Wife' section teaser.
Luxury Lounge - use for representing 'Chatrooms & Forums' or 'Private Community'.
Clear long stem martini glass - use as ambient imagery for lifestyle/pricing section.

icons.style: Duotone weight for luxury, elegant feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over dark backgrounds has at least 4.5:1 contrast. Use Text Shadow on hero text over images.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold-accent).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Bookup your Hookup' - an exclusive swinger site for North AL / South TN residents.
Crucial Flow 1: Registration MUST include a file upload step for 'Residency Proof' and a pending state requiring Admin Approval.
Crucial Flow 2: Gated Content. Unauthenticated and non-premium members should see blurred images/videos with a 'Premium Required' overlay. Only Premium can view clear media and use chat.
Ensure the design remains sophisticated and 'luxury club' style, avoiding cheap, spammy aesthetics common in adult sites.
Implement 'Pretty Pussy of the Week' as a prominent spotlight card on the member dashboard.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, and complex interactive components, but override the default 'Vercel' look to match the dark, luxurious theme.
Data Test IDs MUST be added to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Make it creative and distinctive.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Never use placeholders for images. Always use the provided image URLs.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
